articles.summary: Solid Power, Inc. (Nasdaq: SLDP), a leading developer of solid-state battery technology, today announced its operational and financial results for the third quarter of 2026. Recent Business Highlights Introduced materials into our MOBIUS™ continuous electrolyte production line, with full commissioning expected by year-end 2026. MOBIUS™ will add 45 metric tons of annual electrolyte production capacity, increasing total annual capacity to 75 metric tons. Furthered discussions with leading battery material manufacturing companies regarding a potential joint venture for commercial-scale electrolyte production in the Republic of Korea. Provided electrolyte material to key customers including Samsung SDI and SK On in the third quarter. Completed Stage 2 of the ISO 9001 certification process, with certification on track for year-end 2026.
